t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different gnome colours pick up different baskets. There are 6 colours in total - green, blue and another pick up one colour basket and yellow, pink and another pick up yellow baskets. Start with one basket group - when the mushrooms start to decrease, switch to the other. Repeat.

vb_textbox.text: The blue, yellow and green gnomes show the yellow basket and the red, orange brown, pink and purple gnomes show the red basket.Pick one basket colour to start with and keep picking the corresponding gnomes i.e. green, blue, green, yellow, green, blue, green. Once the amount of mushrooms diminishes significantly, start choosing the gnomes to bring up the other basket i.e. red, pink, red, brown, orange, red, pink etc.
